author: Tulipasylvestris
why: Second computing image, so the 15 computing cards do not all show one photograph: people round a table writing code on laptops, which is what a computing degree looks like when it is collaborative.
cropNote: Centre crop keeps the table of laptops and the coders; the upper third is a bare concrete wall and a blank projection screen, a quiet ground under the light end of the overlay. Only incidental is a small QR-code notice on the wall, illegible at card size; no banner or stage.

author: Olimar
why: Second business image, so the 13 business cards do not all show one photograph: a hand placing dot-votes on sticky notes in a SWOT grid, the textbook strategy tool of a business degree.
cropNote: Centre crop holds the hand, the dots and the quadrant lines on white paper; the notes' handwriting is Finnish and illegible at card size. Pale overall, so it fades cleanly under the paper overlay and reads as texture in dark mode.
